verdict.rationale: Render documents a public REST API (render-docs-15), and a probe confirmed a machine-readable OpenAPI spec at render.com/openapi.json (render-probe-3), so agents can drive the platform programmatically. Supporting programmatic surfaces include an official CLI (render-docs-27, render-probe-4), an MCP server with a deploy-trigger tool (render-docs-24, render-docs-25) and webhooks (render-docs-31). Missing for 10: substantive API doc excerpts (endpoint coverage, API-key auth and rate limits are unevidenced beyond a nav title), and independent or hands-on corroboration of real API usage.
